name: Neo98 & Neo75 Prebuilt Mechanical Keyboard
sourceText:
Experience premium mechanical typing without the complexity of building your own keyboard. The Neo98 and Neo75 Prebuilt Mechanical Keyboards combine Neo Studio’s minimalist design, precision-crafted aluminium construction and refined acoustic performance in a complete, ready-to-use package.
Choose the Neo75 for a compact, desk-friendly layout that keeps essential navigation and function keys within easy reach, or select the Neo98 for a more complete layout with a dedicated number pad. Both options are designed for work, gaming and everyday use.
Smooth, Responsive Typing
Pre-installed London Fog V2 mechanical switches deliver smooth keystrokes, responsive rebound and a comfortable typing experience. Rated for up to 50 million keystrokes, they are built to support reliable long-term use.
Refined Gasket-Mounted Construction
A gasket structure combined with multiple internal foam layers helps soften each keystroke while reducing hollow resonance and unwanted impact noise. The result is a cleaner, more balanced sound profile and a smoother overall typing feel.
Flexible Three-Mode Connectivity
Connect the keyboard to multiple devices using its versatile three-mode connectivity. Quickly switch between wired operation, low-latency 2.4GHz wireless and Bluetooth to suit your desktop, laptop or mobile setup.
A convenient one-click control also makes it easy to switch between Windows and macOS modes.
Durable Double-Shot Keycaps
The included double-shot keycaps feature clear, high-precision legends designed to resist fading. A small amount of PBT is incorporated to improve durability while maintaining a smooth and comfortable surface.
Customisable RGB Lighting
Integrated RGB lighting adds a modern touch to your workspace or gaming setup. Personalise the appearance of your keyboard and create an atmosphere that complements your desk.
Key Features
Fully assembled and ready to use
Available in Neo98 and Neo75 layouts
Precision-crafted aluminium case
London Fog V2 mechanical switches
Gasket-mounted structure
Multi-layer acoustic foam
Wired, Bluetooth and 2.4GHz wireless connectivity
Windows and macOS compatibility
Durable double-shot keycaps
Customisable RGB lighting
Smooth typing feel with refined sound performance
One-year functionality warranty
What’s Included
Neo98 or Neo75 prebuilt mechanical keyboard
Dust cover
USB cable with Type-C shielding ring
Switch puller
Keycap puller

2.4GHz extension adapter

Printed quick-start guide
Designed for users who appreciate premium materials, understated aesthetics and satisfying mechanical performance, the Neo98 and Neo75 deliver a polished custom-keyboard experience straight out of the box.

name: WOBKEY Rainy 75 UK ISO Layout Mechancial Keyboard
sourceText:
UK ISO Layout Typists, Your Rainy75 Has Arrived.
We didn’t just add a new layout—we made sure it still feels like Rainy in every detail.
This isn’t just UK ISO. It’s Rainy75, through and through.
🧊 CNC Aluminum Case
It’s milled from a solid block of aluminum, and you can feel it the moment you pick it up—cold, dense, and ridiculously clean.
📶 Tri-Mode Connectivity
Use it wired, over Bluetooth, or 2.4G. It just works—on your laptop, tablet, or whatever you’re typing on today.
🔋 Battery
The Pro version comes with a massive 7000mAh battery —so powerful, you’ll forget the last time you charged it.
💡 RGB Backlight
Yes, it lights up. Beautifully. South-facing LEDs mean your keycaps look as good as the glow.
🧸 Gasket Mount & Damping
Typing on this doesn’t just sound good—it feels soft, thanks to layers of foam and 14 little silicone dampers under the PCB.
🎯 Kailh Cocoa Switches
Smooth, pre-lubed, and quietly addictive. Cocoa switches glide with just the right amount of resistance.

name: WOBKEY ZEN 65 Limited Edition Copper Keyboard Kit
sourceText:
ZEN 65 · Copper Limited Keyboard Kit Limited Edition | 65% Custom Mechanical Keyboard Kit
The WOBKEY ZEN 65 Copper is a true collector’s piece—a limited edition keyboard kit crafted for enthusiasts who value feel, sound, and craftsmanship.
Starting from a solid 4 kg copper block, precision CNC machining removes over 2.3 kg of material, leaving a dense 1.7 kg copper base. Every curve, cavity, and chamber is carefully carved to deliver exceptional acoustics and tactile feedback.
Paired with a warm silver anodized aluminum top cover, the keyboard balances weight, stability, and refined aesthetics. The included PVD mirror-polished stainless steel weight and etched nameplates add understated elegance while increasing stability.
Inside the copper base, you can switch between four different typing configurations, tuning hardness and damping to your preference. With high-quality Poron and IXPE damping layers, every keystroke feels solid, smooth, and satisfying.

Rainy 75 Pro Black(Silent SHHH Switch Edition)
sourceText:
Rainy 75 Pro Black — Silent SHHH Switch Edition
Not every mechanical keyboard needs to be loud.
With the new SHHH Switch , Rainy 75 Pro Black brings a softer, calmer side to the typing experience. It is not completely silent — instead, it is tuned to reduce harshness and unnecessary noise while keeping the solid feel and satisfying feedback that makes a mechanical keyboard enjoyable.
For late-night work, shared spaces, focused gaming, or long hours at the desk, SHHH Switch offers a smoother sound profile that feels easier to live with every day.
Less noise.
More focus.
A softer way to enjoy Rainy 75 Pro Black.

name: WOBKEY Rainy 75 Linear & Silent SHHH Switches（70PCS）
sourceText:
SHHH Switch Make Every Keystroke a Little Softer.
SHHH Switch is designed for people who love mechanical keyboards, but don’t always want the sound to take over the room.
It keeps the smooth, clean feel of a linear switch, while the rubber-dampened stem helps soften the sound of each press. It’s not completely silent — it simply makes typing feel calmer, gentler, and easier to enjoy every day.
With a light 45±5gf operating force, SHHH Switch feels effortless for long typing sessions, gaming, and everyday use. The POM + rubber stem and nylon housing work together to create a softer, more controlled sound profile without making the switch feel dull.
Less sharp.
Less distracting.
Still satisfying.

Top Housing: Nylon
Bottom Housing: Nylon
Operating Force: 45±5gf
Pre-Travel: 2.0±0.5mm
Total Travel: 3.75±0.3mm

name: Rainy 75 Pro Mithril Keyboard
sourceText:
Rainy 75 Pro Mithril
A New Expression of Pro.
We created the Rainy 75 Pro Mithril for those who believe a keyboard is more than a tool — it is part of the space where they create, work, and express themselves.
Inspired by the refined character of Mithril silver, the Pro Edition combines CNC aluminum craftsmanship with a refined metallic finish and a distinctive tempered glass back panel, creating a design that feels both modern and unique.
The frosted shine-through keycaps transform RGB lighting into a soft, atmospheric glow, creating a refined visual experience that complements the Mithril aesthetic.
Paired with Foggy Linear Switches, every keystroke delivers a smooth and satisfying feel that completes the experience.
Designed for modern desktop setups, Rainy 75 Pro Mithril offers flexible tri-mode connectivity and a 7000mAh rechargeable battery, giving you the flexibility to move seamlessly between work, creativity, and play.
Rainy 75 Pro Mithril — where thoughtful design meets the feeling of every keystroke.

name: WOBKEY Rainy 75 x Salome Gaming Keyboard
sourceText:
The iconic Rainy75 Pro, reimagined for Hyakumantenbara Salome.
This special Rainy 75 × NIJISANJI edition brings an exclusive Hyakumantenbara Salome design to the Rainy75 Pro, pairing it with the signature sound, feel, and all-aluminum construction of the original.
A CNC-machined 6063 aluminum case , gasket-mounted structure , and FR4 plate create a solid yet responsive typing feel. Pre-lubed Kailh Cocoa linear switches keep every keystroke smooth and satisfying, with the rich sound that gives Rainy75 its distinctive character.
The compact 75% layout keeps essential keys within reach while freeing up more room for mouse movement. With USB-C, 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth , and a 7000mAh battery , it’s ready for both competitive play and everyday use.
